headline: Man United tight-lipped with Carrick back at Carrington on Tuesday
description: Under-fire Manchester United boss Michael Carrick arrived at Carrington early on Tuesday morning with his future still up in the air.

headline: Ranked: Every Premier League team's money-per-points (after Man City cheated)
description: How much did Premier League teams spend for points -- after Man City cheated? We find out which clubs were wasteful and which spent smart.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid eye Liverpool's Alexis Mac Allister
description: Liverpool midfielder Alexis Mac Allister has admirers at Real Madrid, while the Reds line up potential replacements. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Is it too soon for Chelsea to regret getting rid of Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson?
description: Nicolas Jackson scored twice to beat Manchester City 2-1 this past weekend, ending their perfect start to the Premier League season while hauling Villa up the table after a slow start.

headline: Manchester City charges: Features, explainers, what's next after guilty verdict

headline: Harry Kane thanks Tottenham, pays tribute to England after Ballon d'Or win
description: Harry Kane thanked Tottenham for helping him fulfil his dreams and paid tribute to his international teammates after becoming the first Englishman in 25 years to win the Ballon d'Or.
